Title: Quality-Adjusted Cost + Savings Analytics
Summary: Answers the brief's question - 'what is the real expected cost of obtaining a VERIFIED successful result?' - NOT 'which model is cheapest per attempt?'. The unit of analysis is the attempt-chain cost per verified success (failed attempts + retry/escalation included), never the single attempt price. Core principle proven by S02: Model A Rs.2/attempt x 4 = Rs.8 verified success vs Model B Rs.5/attempt x 1 = Rs.5; cheap attempt price does not win. Verified success is authoritative: VerificationResult=VERIFIED plus an accepted Claude review state where review is required, over model self-reported success (S07-S12); FAILED verification contradicts a model PASS and a review PENDING rejects the chain. Every paid/real attempt contributes to chain cost (fail Rs.3 + fail Rs.6 + pass Rs.10 = Rs.19, never Rs.10; S01/S03); BUDGET_STOPPED/BLOCKED/WAITING_HUMAN/PENDING are never fabricated as AI attempts and never add cost (S05/S06). Missing cost is counted only for EXECUTED attempts (S04). ExpectedCostPerVerifiedSuccess is OBSERVED_CHAINS at MODERATE/HIGH confidence and a clearly-labelled COLD_START_SIMPLE estimate otherwise (S15-S17). Savings compare equivalent verified outcomes only, with an explicit baseline type and basis; AbsoluteSavings = baseline - candidate observed cost-per-success, SavingsPercent = absolute / baseline when baseline > 0 (S18-S23); AvoidedRetryCost is labelled ESTIMATED/COUNTERFACTUAL (S24). Provider-failure cost (rate-limit/gateway/outage) is kept separate from model-quality failure cost (S25/S26); escalation cost is visible as the full cheap->fail->stronger->success chain (S27). Currency: only reporting-currency cost evidence contributes; historic cost in another currency is NEVER re-converted (S28/S29). LOCAL is NEVER automatically FREE: LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN with operational cost unknown, never invented (S30/S31); remote is PRICE_UNKNOWN/FREE/CONFIGURED (S32). Confidence reuses DB-M24 bands READ-ONLY (INSUFFICIENT/LOW/MODERATE/HIGH; S33/S34). Filters/grouping cover ProviderId/ModelId/UnderlyingModelId/Gateway/TaskType/Complexity/Risk/ReasoningLevel/ExecutionMode/LocalOrRemote and ModelRoute default; time windows; LocalOrRemote group-by (S37-S41). Policy comparison is ANALYSIS ONLY (CHEAPEST_ELIGIBLE/CHEAPEST_RELIABLE/BEST_COST_PER_SUCCESS/HIGHEST_SUCCESS/BALANCED), PolicyVersion stays the immutable 0.0.0, rows are labelled COUNTERFACTUAL unless observed, config/ai-routing.json byte-identical (S49). AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE; no provider/model executed; 0 paid API calls; 0 network calls. All 17 DB-M14/M16/M17/M19/M20/M21/M22/M23/M24 frozen implementation files verified byte-identical (SHA-256 before/after, S43-S45). NO workbook/Nexus/lifecycle writes (S46, grep-verified zero write tokens).
